name: deck_lint
description: Lint the bundle (SPEC §7.5): validation, the document rules, then layout, contrast, motion, and narrative in every format it lists. Findings carry a JSON pointer, and a fix when one is safe; `fix` applies them.

bundle.description: The bundle: a directory, a `.scaena` zip, or a `deck.json`.

state.description: Only the findings in this state.

fix.description:
Apply the fixes lint offers (each checked by laying its state out again; never a
change of content), write the deck, and lint again.

Finding.description: One lint finding, shaped for agents: a code, a JSON pointer, and (when safe) a fix.

file.description: The bundle file `path` points into, when it is not `deck.json` (a theme file).

format.description: The format the deck was laid out in (`"9:16"`), when it is not the deck's own.

fix.description: A JSON Patch (RFC 6902) that resolves the finding. Only safe, non-content fixes.

fixed.description: The findings whose fixes were applied, under `fix`.

laid.description:
Whether the layout rules ran: they run once validation and the document rules
find no error.
